newsitem.title: USA: Intermagnetics expects higher revenues, profits.
newsitem.headline: Intermagnetics expects higher revenues, profits.

text.p: Intermagnetics General Corp said on Wednesday that it expects to report higher revenues and profits in the fiscal year ending May 25, 1997.
The projection is based on the expectation that it will be increasingly successful in attempts to generate new products and market opportunities, the company said.
In the 1995 fiscal year, the company posted net income of about $4 million, or $0.34 per share.
The company develops and manufactures refrigerants and permanent magnet-based magnetic resonance imaging systems.
